thread:
maria: Heads up: customer report — audit export (CSV) from Console returns 403 for accounts with 'audit-viewer' role when row-level KMS masking is enabled.
sec-bot: [alert] export-job 0xdeadbeef failed for org-id 12345 - status 403. https://console.redwood.ai/ops/exports/0xdeadbeef
ajay: Can you paste the exact error and the API request/headers?
maria: Error pasted below:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"export.download requires audit.export.download scope"}
``` 
Also see request: `POST /api/exports?format=csv` body includes filter `kms_masked=true`.
kevin: This smells like the RBAC rename we deployed last week. We flipped internal scope from `export.download` -> `audit.export.download` but some service principals still using old scope translation.
olivia: Separately, exporter pipeline is choking on events with the new schema fields. Sample event that blows up serializer:
```
{"ts":1680000000, "actor":{"id":"u-123"}, "action":"CONFIG_CHANGE", "resource":{"id":"r-1"}, "kms": {"masked": true}}
```
No `kms.key_id` present -> exporter tried to deref and NPE'd.
ajay: Repro steps for us:
1) Create org with KMS masking enabled
2) Give a user only `audit-viewer` role
3) Use Console UI export CSV -> 403
4) Call API with admin token -> success
maria: Customer impact: 3 enterprise customers blocked from getting audit CSVs, affects quarterly compliance window.
kevin: Short term workaround: admin token or grant `audit.export.download` to service principal. Long term fix needed.
olivia: Proposed action items:
- (olivia) Harden exporter: null-safe access for `kms.*`, add boolean `kms.masked` to CSV headers if present
- (kevin) Adjust RBAC translation to accept both legacy `export.download` and new `audit.export.download` scopes for 30d
- (ajay) Add test harness to simulate masked events + streaming pagination with chunk sizes
- (maria) Notify affected customers with temporary workaround and ETA
I'll open PRs and link here.
ajay: Also add telemetry counter `audit.export.fail.reason` with tags `{reason:rbac|schema|kms, org_id}` so support can filter.
sec-bot: deploy-plan: canary to us-east-1 scheduled 2h after PR merge. CI: 42/48 passing flaky tests noted.
maria: OK assign owners, please ping when PR link ready. :thumbsup:
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9453 (rbac compat) — tests + changelog
olivia: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9454 (exporter null-safety + streaming cursor)
ajay: I added metric dashboard draft and alert rule. Will share in #observability.
maria: Thanks all — keeping customer updated. We'll do post-mortem after fix.
